name: megascenes-storybook
description: Illustrate a short picture book page by page, with the same characters and the same style on every page, from a story you write in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Write a short story in the chat with ChatGPT, a few pages with characters of your own, then illustrate it one page at a time: say what happens on the page, who the characters are and the style, soft watercolor, bold flat colors or colored pencil. From the second page on, the first page is passed as a reference so the characters and the style stay the same. You get one illustrated page per run, landscape, portrait or square.

The text of the story stays in the chat, not on the pictures, so you can set it under each page in the layout you like.

ChatGPT tells you what each page needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The pages open in the chat and stay in your library.

For parents, grandparents and teachers making a story of their own, for bedtime, a gift or a class project.

Limitations: one illustrated page per run, without the story text on it; original characters only, not characters or brands owned by others. It does not print or bind the book. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Illustrate a picture book one page at a time
The same characters and style on every page
Return each page in the chat
defaultPrompt: Help me write a short story about Mia and her fox friend Pip, then illustrate the first page
Illustrate page 2: Mia and Pip find a glowing door in the forest
A soft watercolor picture book page of a little bear who is afraid of the dark

positive.prompt: Illustrate the first page of my story: Mia, a girl with curly red hair and a yellow raincoat, and Pip, a small orange fox, find a glowing door in the forest. Soft watercolor. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one illustrated page needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Illustrate page 2 with the same Mia and Pip, using the first page in my MegaScenes library as the reference: they step through the door into a garden of giant flowers. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one more page needs, with the first page found in the library as the reference. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can illustrate a storybook page here?
positive.expected_behavior: The storybook page models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Illustrate the first page of a story about Bruno, a small brown bear in a green scarf who is afraid of the dark, looking at the moon from his window. Soft watercolor. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my storybook page on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my storybook page to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
